description: This file defines the `PackingSession` class, which manages the state and operations of a shipment packing process. It handles adding items to packages, creating shipment records, managing packaging lines, calculating quantities and weights, and finalizing the shipment. The class interacts with OFBiz's entity engine and services to orchestrate the shipment packing workflow.

classes.name: PackingSession
classes.description: Main class managing the packing process, including lines, events, shipment creation, and package management.

methods.name: addOrIncreaseLine
methods.description: Adds or increases the quantity of an item line in the packing session, handling inventory reservations and existing pack lines.

methods.name: findLine
methods.description: Finds a specific packing session line based on order, product, and package identifiers.

methods.name: createPackLineItem
methods.description: Creates a new packing session line after validation, updating package weights.

methods.name: checkLineForAdd
methods.description: Checks whether the inventory reservation can accommodate the requested addition or update.

methods.name: getPackedQuantity
methods.description: Calculates the total packed quantity for various contexts (by order, product, package).

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Finalizes the packing session, creating shipment, packages, issuing items, and updating related entities.

methods.name: createShipment
methods.description: Creates the shipment record in the system based on current packing state.

methods.name: createPackages
methods.description: Generates shipment packages using configured box types and weights.

methods.name: issueItemsToShipment
methods.description: Issues the packed items to the shipment, updating shipment lines.

methods.name: runEvents
methods.description: Executes registered packing events during various stages.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Retrieves the Delegator instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Retrieves the LocalDispatcher instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: setShipmentBoxType
methods.description: Assigns a box type to a specific package.

methods.name: getShipmentBoxType
methods.description: Retrieves the box type assigned to a specific package.

methods.name: setPackageWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight for a specific package.

methods.name: getPackageWeight
methods.description: Retrieves the weight of a specific package.

methods.name: addToPackageWeight
methods.description: Adds weight to the current weight of a specified package.

inner_classes.name: ItemDisplay
inner_classes.description: Helper class representing item details for display and processing within the packing session.
